visual.title: List the two-subsets
visual.caption: A combination ignores order, so each k-subset is listed once. Counting the listed rows gives the binomial coefficient.

predict.question: How many two-element subsets does a five-element set have?
predict.explain: 5 choose 2 is 10, and the figure lists exactly ten unordered pairs.
